body.name: YF
body.def: For every unit observed in \(\mathcal D_n^{h,\rho}\), the Fisher completion indexed by the same design value sets \(\widetilde Y^{0,\mathcal D(\rho)}_{nksi}(0)=\widetilde Y^{0,\mathcal D(\rho)}_{nksi}(1)=Y^{\mathrm{obs},k}_{nsi}\); no equality between \(Y^{(h)}(1)\) and \(Y^{(h)}(0)\) is imposed when \(h\ne0\).
body.role: sharp-null completion used only by rerandomization
